analyst_view.overall: Brann are 7th in the Conference League with 7 points and unbeaten in Europe (wins over Lincoln and Zalgiris, a draw at Sint-Truiden), so a home win would put them close to a top-8 place. In Norway they are only 7th, with nothing big left to play for, which suggests Europe gets their strongest side; they played away at KFUM on 22 Nov and host Kristiansund on 29 Nov. AGF are 24th on 2 points, 8th in the Danish league with just two league wins in 13, and lost 0-2 at Brondby on 1 Nov. No injuries, suspensions or referee were reported for either side; news for this match was thin (fixture pages and club form pages), so the view rests on form and motivation.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, 1.9 for Brann at home. Brann should be at full strength with the league season fading, and AGF have drawn a lot this season; neither pushes me off the numbers, so I stay at about 3.1.

corners.text: The numbers expect 12.0 corners and already add for Brann's strong recent corner count (40 in six) and cut AGF's. I found no lineup or tactical news beyond that, so I stay at about 12.

cards.text: The numbers expect 3.9 cards, 2.4 of them for AGF, and AGF's recent card rate is already counted. No referee is named yet and there's no rivalry edge, so I stay at about 3.9.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.9 shots, with Brann at 18.5 and already lifted for their recent shooting and AGF's leaky defence. Brann's motivation to push for the top eight fits that picture rather than adding to it, so I stay at about 28.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.6 shots on target and already lift Brann and trim AGF for recent form. Nothing I found changes that, so I stay at about 10.6.
